query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) as total_cat1_avulso,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) as total_cat2_produtos,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) as total_cat3_serv_extra,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) as total_cat4_auxiliar,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) as total_cat5_recorrencia,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(10,2))), 0) as total_geral
FROM faturamentos
WHERE tenantId = 1 AND MONTH(data) = 3 AND YEAR(data) = 2026
  AND empresaSlug IN ('MASCOTE', 'MORUMBI')
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
